pipeline: L2(concat[L2(SigLIP2 512d ONNX fp16), 0.8*L2(DINOv2-B@224 512d ONNX fp16)]) + GPU-preproc (CUDA letterbox+normalize+IOBinding) + per-query k-reciprocal (k1=8,k2=3,lam=0.5,pool=300); TTA OFF (224-only)
selection_rule: max 0.7*F1 + 0.3*TNR (tie: F1, then TNR, then lower threshold); calibrated ONLY on the val split, not on test
note: Recalibrated for the variant-A deploy scale: 224-only GPU-preproc fusion, no crop cache. The previous fp16 constant 0.6897585988 was fitted to the 224/280 TTA scale; on the 224-only scale this point is the argmax of the candidate score. Consumed by service.infer.run.resolve_threshold (order: --threshold -> env -> this file -> reid.calibrate default).
